decisions.quantity: Plain number plus unit label; no conversions
decisions.import: JSON import adds records and never replaces existing records

features.name: Firebase foundation
features.title: Set up Firebase project and app integration
features.description: Configure Firebase services and connect the Vite app without committed secrets.
acceptance: Firebase project services are configured for local development
The Vite app initializes Firebase without committed secrets
Authentication, Firestore, and Hosting configuration is documented

features.name: Google authentication
features.title: Add Google authentication
features.description: Provide Google sign-in, sign-out, session persistence, and protected inventory content.
acceptance: A user can sign in with Google
A signed-in user can sign out
Signed-out users cannot access inventory content
Refreshing the app preserves the Firebase session

features.name: Seed inventory CRUD
features.title: Build seed inventory CRUD
features.description: Create, view, edit, archive, and permanently delete per-user seed records.
acceptance: A user can create, view, edit, archive, and permanently delete seed records
Forms validate required fields and non-negative quantities
Records persist in the signed-in user's Firestore collection

features.name: Quantity adjustments
features.title: Add quantity adjustment controls
features.description: Allow quick non-negative quantity increases and decreases.
acceptance: Users can increase or decrease quantity from the inventory workflow
Quantities cannot become negative
A zero quantity is visibly treated as empty

features.name: Search and filtering
features.title: Add inventory search, filters, and sorting
features.description: Search, filter, and sort active and archived inventory records.
acceptance: Users can search variety, crop, location, and notes
Users can filter availability, crop, location, and archived state
Users can sort by name, quantity, and viability date

features.name: Inventory dashboard
features.title: Build inventory dashboard
features.description: Show inventory totals and viability attention items.
acceptance: Dashboard counts exclude archived records by default
Empty, low-stock, soon-to-expire, and expired states are represented
Attention items link to relevant inventory results

features.name: Additive JSON backup
features.title: Add additive JSON import and export
features.description: Export inventory and validate additive imports without replacement.
acceptance: A user can export their inventory as JSON
A valid JSON file can add records to the existing inventory
Malformed files are rejected before any write occurs
Import previews the record count and requires confirmation

features.name: Firestore security and errors
features.title: Add Firestore security rules and error states
features.description: Enforce user isolation and handle loading, permission, write, and offline failures.
acceptance: Firestore rules prevent cross-user reads and writes
Loading, save failure, permission failure, and offline states are handled
Security verification evidence is recorded in progress.md

features.name: Firebase Hosting deployment
features.title: Deploy MVP with Firebase Hosting
features.description: Deploy the production Vite app with SPA routing and verified Firebase services.
acceptance: The production build deploys to Firebase Hosting
SPA route refreshes do not return 404
Google sign-in and Firestore writes work in production
The production URL and deployment steps are documented
